BiblicalUsage: Nahalol is pasture or a meadow, and its only occurrence is among the places where the enemy rests. In Isaiah 7:19 they shall come and rest in the desolate valleys and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns and upon all bushes, and the pastures are named among the places left empty.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a pasture with no flock in it is a picture of a land under judgment; the grass grows, but no one is there to feed on it.
